reasons: The cited Section 11.6 is a genuine, usable insurance covenant (CGL with aggregate limits including Clinical Trial Insurance, workers' compensation at statutory limits, employer's liability, rated carriers, additional-insured status, certificates on request, and claims-made tail cover), so the 'missing' trigger for this rule is not engaged.
Claimed status is compliant and, consistent with the expectation for compliant findings, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

The rationale correctly treats the shortfalls (redacted [***] limits, absence of a separate E&O/cyber line) as noted sub-elements rather than material deviations, given this is a development/option collaboration rather than a data-processing or on-premises services engagement, so the walk-away trigger is not met.
Section 11.6.3 (AbbVie self-insurance) benefits our party and was properly left undisturbed.
Minor: quantum cannot be verified because limits are redacted; the rationale appropriately flags this for confirmation against disclosure schedules rather than asserting compliance on limits.
